description: A menu item that opens a nested actions menu.

tags.devx:
- Place it inside a `Menu purpose="actions"` and compose `MenuItem` children inside it.
- The nested menu inherits the parent variant and is labelled from `label` unless `accessibleLabel` is provided.
tags.a11y:
- Exposes `aria-haspopup="menu"` and `aria-expanded` on its trigger.
- Arrow Right (Arrow Left in RTL) opens and focuses the first item; the opposite arrow or Escape closes and restores trigger focus.
- Pointer hover opens the submenu; clicking an action inside it closes that submenu.
tags.limitations: - Use only in action menus, not in `purpose="selection"` listboxes.

label.name: label
label.description: Visible name for the submenu trigger.

leadingIcon.name: leadingIcon
leadingIcon.description: Optional icon displayed before the trigger label.

disabled.name: disabled
disabled.description: Prevents opening the nested menu and removes the trigger from navigation.

variant.name: variant
variant.description: Overrides the color treatment inherited from the parent Menu.

accessibleLabel.name: accessibleLabel
accessibleLabel.description: Accessible name for the nested menu; defaults to "{label} submenu".

children.name: children
children.description: MenuItem, MenuGroup, and MenuHeadline content for the nested menu.

className.name: className
className.description: Classes merged onto the submenu trigger.

triggerClasses.name: triggerClasses
triggerClasses.description: Classes applied to the submenu trigger using the MenuItem style contract.
